market_question: Will Eleni Kounalakis win the California Governor Election in 2026?
reasoning: Eleni Kounalakis, the sitting Lieutenant Governor of California, is a credible Democratic candidate in the 2026 open governor race. Although not the poll leader, she has statewide name recognition and a viable path in the top-two primary; early polls show her in double digits (~14%). A 0.2% implied chance is grossly mispriced given her institutional backing and the Democratic lean of the state, making her true odds at least 7.5%.
evidence_points: UC Berkeley IGS poll (early 2025) has Kounalakis at 14% in the primary field
She has won two statewide elections as Lieutenant Governor, demonstrating fundraising and organizational capacity
California's top-two primary system allows multiple Democrats to advance, giving a non-frontrunner like her a plausible general-election opportunity
